rows.description: A cross-platform desktop All-in-One assistant for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode,DeepSeek Harness and more. Only official website: ccswitch.io
Coding agent memory for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and 40 more, built from the session history already on your disk. Local search, MCP and hooks, no LLM, one Go binary.

Semi-automated research assistant for academic research and software development. Supports Claude Code, Codex CLI, Kimi Code CLI, and OpenCode across ideation, coding, experiments, writing, and publication.

All-in-one AI desktop app: one-click install for Claude Code, Codex CLI, DeepSeek and more, manage AI accounts and quotas, smart model routing with auto-failover, voice input, and run local LLMs. Bonus: a Token Pet that grows as you use AI.
